figurative_meaning_en: Fame or renown for power and wealth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ব্যবসায়ীর হাঁকডাক শহরজুড়ে ছড়িয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The businessman's pomp has spread throughout the city.
The king's renown for power and wealth has impressed everyone.
note: This idiom often evokes images of feudal lords or wealthy figures in Bengali folklore.
